physicalNotes: Radius 1.49 Jupiter radii from Addison et al. 2021 (2021AJ....162..292A), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....162..292A/abstract): 106,523.1 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius.
